summary: Full-stack testing of Caro PHV marketplace MVP. Backend: 28/28 pytest cases pass across listings (filters/sort/detail/view-tracking), quote engine, auth (register/login/me/logout, duplicate rejection, bearer + cookie), applications (create + /me), interest, stats, and admin (summary, per-collection list, RBAC 403, CSV export). Frontend: full e2e Playwright walkthrough — homepage loads 12 listings, chips + sort filter, vehicle detail opens, driver register lands on /portal, login works, multi-step apply flow submits and shows success screen, application appears in /portal, operator interest form submits with success screen, admin login shows summary stats + all 5 tabs (leads/applications/interests/users/events) rendering tables and CSV export button, driver-guide and operator-guide pages render.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS: allow_origins defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True — invalid per CORS spec; browsers will reject cookies. Should default to a specific origin (FRONTEND_URL). Cookie auth still works in-app because frontend uses Bearer fallback via api client, but pure cookie flow across origins may fail.
server.py mixes API + models + seeding + auth in a single 395-line file. Acceptable now but should be split (routers/, models/, auth/) as it grows past ~700 lines.
@app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated in FastAPI; migrate to lifespan handler.
seed_listings inserts raw dicts from seed_data.LISTINGS with no schema validation; verify Pydantic listing model or index on 'id' for lookups (currently unindexed => O(n) scans).
No rate limiting / brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login — playbook_testing_instructions request this; missing.
Admin endpoints return raw docs with no pagination; /admin/{collection} returns up to 1000 rows. Fine for MVP, add pagination before scaling.
test_credentials: Admin admin@caro.co.uk / CaroAdmin2026!. Fresh driver testdriver+<uuid>@example.com / Test1234! (created per test).
seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral drivers, applications, and TEST_-prefixed operator interests. No cleanup performed — safe for MVP DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All listed features work end-to-end. Backend pytest file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — run: pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. Frontend testids: reg-*/login-*/int-* are on Input elements directly; apply-* are on wrapping div (use '[data-testid="apply-dob"] input'). Console shows 401 on /api/auth/me before auth and a few 404s on /portal (likely image resources) — not functional bugs.
